objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-applocker-privilege-escalation-via-unauthorized-bypass
objects.description: The following analytic utilizes Windows AppLocker event logs to identify attempts to bypass application restrictions. AppLocker is a feature that allows administrators to specify which applications are permitted to run on a system. This analytic is designed to identify attempts to bypass these restrictions, which could be indicative of an attacker attempting to escalate privileges.
